title: DW3 port mod.json (mod-v1)
description: The manifest of a mod: <pref>/mods/<mod>/mod.json. Derived from checkMod in pc/shim/mods.c.

$schema.description: Optional; points editors at this schema.

format.description: Always mod-v1; another value rejects the mod.

name.description: Informational. The id other mods and settings.ini use is the folder name.

version.description: Digits and dots (1.2.0); a -suffix is ignored when comparing. 0 when missing.

kind.description: assets replaces resources; content also adds items, techniques and Digimon (content/*.json is read only for content mods).

port.description: Minimum port version, like >=0.4. An older port disables the mod.

requires.description: Mods it depends on, by folder name: base or base>=1.2. At most 8.
